thread:
paul_acme: Hi, seeing a spike of 504s from the hosted inference API around 11:20 UTC. Customer job uploads start streaming and then we get gateway timeouts. Happening across three regions (us-west1, eu-west1, ap-south1). Example request-id: req_8a2f7c1b. SDK v0.9.4. Can someone look?

eng-support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4587, assigned to support oncall.

sara: @paul_acme thanks — can you paste a minimal repro? is it streaming (chunked) or single POST?

paul_acme: streaming. We stream large multipart payloads to /v1/infer/stream. Repro steps (local):
```
# node example
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY});
await client.infer.stream({model: 'rw8-large', inputStream: fs.createReadStream('./big.ndjson')});
```
We see retry loop in our app (sdk auto-retries) and lots of 504s in a 3m window.

mike: Can you share raw response headers when you get the 504? any X-Request-ID from our edge?

paul_acme: Sure — sample response:
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 11:21:13 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-ID: req_8a2f7c1b
Server: redwood-edge/2.4.1
Content-Length: 87

{"error":"gateway timeout","details":"upstream read timed out after 30s"}
```

anika: Noted upstream read timed out after 30s. That points to load-balancer/backpressure hitting our streaming proxy. @mike can you check LB metrics around that req id? :eyes:

mike: Pulling metrics now.

mike: Metrics show a short spike in queued connections on the proxy pool for us-west1 at 11:20 UTC. Average request duration jumped from 120ms to ~3.2s for ~180s. No config changes deployed at that time.

julian: Any pattern in payload sizes?

paul_acme: Payloads are ~4-8MB per chunk, total stream ~200MB. We didn't change anything. SDK retry policy is default (exponential, 3 retries). When the 504s hit, our client retried and ended up duplicating some work.

sara: Two parallel threads: (1) triage LB backpressure + streaming timeouts, (2) immediate mitigation for customer to reduce impact.

sara: Mitigations — suggestions:
- temporarily disable client-side auto-retries for streaming calls
- switch to non-streaming bulk upload endpoint (if possible)
- set a longer upstream timeout header: `X-Upstream-Timeout: 90`
- route to dedicated region or dedicated pool if available (Dedicated customers only)

paul_acme: We can try disabling retries. Can you confirm server-side change windows?

mike: No config change needed for you to disable retries client-side. For quick check, please repro with retries off and include curl trace. Also I'll fetch proxy logs for req_8a2f7c1b.

eng-support-bot: deploy-bot reported: rolling restart of edge-proxy group completed in us-west1 at 11:35 UTC (no config diff).

mike: Proxy logs (excerpt):
```
[11:20:12] req_8a2f7c1b conn=203 upstream_connect=50ms upstream_response_wait=30001ms error=upstream_timeout
[11:20:14] req_8a2f7c1b retry_attempt=1 client_ip=34.76.12.9
[11:20:45] req_8a2f7c1b conn=207 dropped_by_backpressure
```
Looks like backpressure kicked in and the proxy dropped some streams after hitting the per-worker in-flight limit.

anika: That aligns with KV cache/backpressure thresholds being exceeded when many concurrent streaming uploads hit the same proxy pool. We have a known tuning knob (stream_inflight_limit) that was conservative for memory safety.

julian: Could this be related to keepalive mismatch? previous incident showed long-lived connections + chunked streams causing file descriptors to cone up. Any FD exhaustion?

mike: FD count spiked but stayed under critical. The drop was driven by per-worker in-flight circuit logic, not system FD limit.

sara: Proposed next steps:
1) Short-term: ask customer to disable retries and add jitter/backoff, reduce chunk size to 1MB and retry test.
2) Mid-term: infra to increase stream_inflight_limit on edge-proxy for the affected pool and monitor for memory regressions.
3) Long-term: add adaptive backpressure that considers stream size and client retries.

paul_acme: Ok we'll repro with retries off and 1MB chunks. ETA 30m. Please keep me posted.

mike: Filed infra ticket INF-9201 to evaluate bumping stream_inflight_limit for us-west1. Assigned to anika.

anika: On it. I'll run a canary bump on a small subset of proxies in us-west1 and watch memory/latency. No code changes, just config.

mike: Also validated that some SDKs (v0.9.x) re-open streaming connections aggressively on partial failures. Might add a server header to suggest clients avoid immediate retries for 5xx: `Retry-After: 30` for stream endpoints. I'll propose in infra ticket.

paul_acme: Repro: after disabling retries and reducing chunk to 1MB we still saw a single 504 but far fewer. Request-id: req_8a2f7d5e. Attached curl trace and timing.

paul_acme: curl trace:
```
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (34.76.12.21) port 443 (#0)
> POST /v1/infer/stream HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.ai
> Authorization: Bearer ****
> Transfer-Encoding: chunked
> User-Agent: Redwood-SDK/0.9.4
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
< X-Request-ID: req_8a2f7d5e
< Retry-After: 30
```

anika: Thanks — that single remaining 504 looks like residual capacity pressure. Canary bump scheduled now. I'll post results in ~15m.

deploy-bot: canary-update: edge-proxy(us-west1)-pool-3 updated stream_inflight_limit from 32 -> 64 at 11:54 UTC. No restarts.

anika: Canary metrics look good: memory delta < 6%, p50 latency unchanged, 504 rate dropped to near zero for pool-3 sample. Rolling this to other pools in us-west1 now.

mike: After rolling out config bump across us-west1, 504 spike subsided. We'll monitor 48h. Also working on adding `Retry-After` on stream 5xx responses.

sara: Communication plan:
- Notify customer that we've applied a safe backpressure bump in us-west1 and recommend disabling client retries until SDK patch is out.
- Engineering will add server-side guidance header and update SDK to backoff more conservatively on streaming 5xx.
- Keep INCIDENT open for 48h monitoring.

paul_acme: Thanks — reduced retries + chunking worked as mitigation. Appreciate the quick turn. Please keep me in the loop on the SDK patch.

mike: Will follow up with a PR link for the header change and a timeline for SDK update.

sara: Closing action items:
- INF-9201 (inflight bump) status: rolling, owner: anika
- SDK-847 (retry behavior for streaming) opened, owner: mike
- COMM-590 (customer note) drafted, owner: julian

paul_acme: Closing on our side, will reopen if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:

eng-support-bot: Incident INC-2026-4587 status changed to monitoring.
